evidenceKind: AI visual review of iOS Simulator smoke

issues.region: top HUD and lower inventory strip
issues.problem: HUD labels and slot details have low contrast against the dark battlefield.
issues.fixCandidate: Raise text and icon contrast without expanding HUD coverage.

issues.problem: Descriptions and rarity labels sit close to card edges and are lower contrast than titles.
issues.fixCandidate: Increase inner padding and secondary-text contrast.

issues.problem: Rare tint reduces separation between card surface, rarity label, and dimmed background.
issues.fixCandidate: Strengthen rare-card border and heading contrast.

issues.problem: Evolution treatment is distinguishable but the purple surface competes with its body text.
issues.fixCandidate: Increase body-text contrast while preserving the evolution distinction.

issues.problem: Result Preview is a sparse runtime placeholder and is not final product-quality result composition.
issues.fixCandidate: Replace the preview body with the approved result hierarchy in a dedicated later pass.
